about: The model router's table (work/20). Tiers by task; the caller names a tier, never a model, unless it must. Slugs are OpenRouter's, read from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models at 12:10 UTC on 11 November 2026 (prices in USD per million tokens: in/out). Change a tier here, nowhere else.

cheap.for: classify, extract, summarise, dedupe, check, draft first passes (open weights)

strong.for: writing that is published, reviews, anything a person will read as ours

hard.for: hard reasoning, the lead's decisions; use sparingly

long.for: a whole page set or repository in one prompt (1M context)

check.for: second-opinion checks: extracts what a public page says; the comparison is done in code; its word is evidence, never fact (the 8B model was too noisy, the lead 12:49 UTC)

note: daily_cap_usd (5, the lead at 12:39 UTC) is counted per session from that session's own ledger, so the team total is the sum over sessions; min_credit_usd: no call is sent when the key's remaining credit is below it.
